section_header: STEERING — Steering Column Assembly with Tilt Steering
ocr_text:
5. REMOVE MAIN SHAFT FROM UPPER BRACKET
(a) Using a soft jaw vise and snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.
(b) Pull out the main shaft from the bracket.

6. DISASSEMBLE TILT STEERING SUPPORT AND COLUMN BRACKET
(a) Remove the two nuts, bolt and retainer.
(b) Take out the collar and release pin.

(c) Remove the tension spring and take out the tilt pawl.

(d) Remove the guide pin bolt, support bolt and shim.

(e) Using a hammer, remove the serration bolt and tilt lever.
